MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing feels like a natural next purchase because it would help insulate wire connections for the battery holders, circuit boards, and relay modules I have bought.",
    "Digital calipers fit my electronics and hardware projects because I can use them to check board sizes and component dimensions; the six-inch option seems sufficient for my needs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Sealant and permanent epoxies require a specific sealing or repair job that my purchases do not establish; buying caster wheels does not mean I need to bond or repair metal.",
    "Adhesive magnets do not serve the electrical purpose of my ferrite toroid cores, and waterproof automotive splices do not clearly fit my breadboard and PCB work.",
    "The spade connectors might be useful only if their terminals fit my components, while the face masks have no clear connection to the supplies I am looking for."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as a broad interest in any DIY or repair supply, even though I choose supplies for particular tasks.",
    "Shared materials or words seem to count too much: ferrite cores do not imply a need for adhesive magnets, and electrical wiring does not automatically imply automotive connectors."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my purchases involve small electronic assemblies, so practical fit with battery leads, boards, and relays matters more to me than a general connection to hardware.",
    "I need a clear use and suitable dimensions or connections before choosing a supply; both calipers fit my interests, but I would only choose the six-inch one this time."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my small electronics projects but stretched that interest into repair materials and connectors without a clear current use."
}
